Infobox for world boss pages, built on [[Module:Infobox]] (DRUID). Every parameter is optional; empty rows are hidden. Labels are translated automatically from [[Module:Labels/data]]. Without <code>image</code> it shows <code>File:&lt;page name&gt;.png</code> when that file exists, or the placeholder otherwise, so uploading <code>File:&lt;page name&gt;.png</code> is enough to replace it.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Infobox World Boss
|title=
|image=
|caption=
|quote=
|World=
|Lair=
|Coordinates=
|How to find=
|Boss key=
|Respawn=
|Health=
|Transforms into=
|Transformed health=
|Minions=
|Signature moves=
|Reward=
|Drops=
|Techniques=
}}
</pre>
